propositions: A close without a completion signature is indistinguishable from a gate-off close when reading from reduced state, because gate state is read and discarded at close time
A completion_expectation enum with eight values must be persisted present-only on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, recording why a signature was or was not expected

The completion_expectation value must be computed from gate state (ENABLED/DISABLED/UNREADABLE) and close path (force, local source, not certifiable, or administrative disposition), with gate state resolving first so forced closes under disabled/unreadable configs record gate_off/gate_unreadable, not force_bypassed

A later reader must combine durable completion_expectation with durable attestation to distinguish three states: required+attestation (signed), required+none (signature lost), and other values indicating signature was not expected

The idea->closed transition must record completion_expectation=not_applicable (a reject/drop, not a completion) and must be set explicitly in the close_ticket function which alone knows the gate never applied
